mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.report_code, d.report_name, d.result_type, d.enable_flag, d.report_script_count_switch, d.report_script_autocamel, d.sort, d.create_time, d.create_by, d.update_time, d.update_by, d.remark, d.version, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM report_definition_param p WHERE p.report_code = d.report_code AND p.deleted = 0) AS param_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM report_definition_result r WHERE r.report_code = d.report_code AND r.deleted = 0) AS result_count FROM report_definition d WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.report_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reportCode},'%') AND d.report_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reportName},'%') AND d.result_type = #{resultType} AND d.enable_flag = #{enableFlag} ORDER BY d.sort, d.id DESC

SELECT id, report_code, report_name, result_type, enable_flag, report_script, report_script_count_switch, report_script_count, report_script_autocamel FROM report_definition WHERE deleted = 0 AND enable_flag = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
